scope: Deterministic bounded property/fuzz preparation for the existing host-testable PNG/JPEG decoder.

strategy.inputs: 2048 deterministic arbitrary byte vectors up to 8192 bytes; 4096 vectors with PNG/JPEG signatures; 1024 deterministic mutations/truncations of existing PNG/JPEG fixtures.
invariants: Inputs are bounded by the decoder's 64 KiB input limit.
Recognized-format inputs return an error or a dimension-bounded image with source and pixel extents consistent.
Any panic fails the host test.

checks.results: 12 decoder tests, 5 snapshot/OOM tests, and 3 upsample tests passed.

checks.result: cargo-fuzz is not installed; no continuous fuzz target or corpus was created.

limitations: This deterministic host sweep is fuzz preparation, not continuous coverage-guided fuzzing.
It does not prove absence of undefined behavior or native process containment.
The decoder dependency graph is unchanged; no fuzzing dependencies or root-workspace changes were added.
No parser crash was found in the tested deterministic sequence; this is not evidence that all malformed inputs are safe.
